text: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，加快人工智能场景化应用，深入实施“人工智能+”行动，加强煤炭领域人工智能数据归集，推进人工智能在勘探设计、建设生产、运营维护、安全管理等重点场景系统化应用。加快研发推广煤炭领域专用大模型，重点突破智能感知、自主决策、智能控制等关键技术瓶颈，培育建设一批人工智能融合应用试点煤矿，促进煤矿安全生产水平提高。大力实施灾害严重矿井、发生较大及以上事故矿井智能化改造，推动危险繁重岗位机器人作业替代。
text_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which calls for accelerating AI scenario applications, deeply implementing the 'AI+' action, strengthening AI data collection in the coal sector, and promoting systematic AI applications in key scenarios such as exploration and design, construction and production, operation and maintenance, and safety management. It aims to accelerate R&D and promotion of coal-specific large models, focus on breakthroughs in key technologies like intelligent perception, autonomous decision-making, and intelligent control, and cultivate a batch of AI application pilot coal mines to improve coal mine safety production. It also calls for implementing intelligent transformation of mines with severe disasters or major accidents, and promoting robot substitution in dangerous and labor-intensive positions.
